description: This file defines the XmlParser class responsible for parsing XML data according to AWS API shapes, supporting REST-XML and Query protocols.

classes.name: XmlParser
classes.description: Implements standard XML parsing for AWS REST-XML and Query protocols.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Entry point for parsing a StructureShape with a SimpleXMLElement value.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches parsing to specific methods based on shape type.

methods.name: parse_structure
methods.description: Parses a structure shape from XML.

methods.name: memberKey
methods.description: Determines the XML node name for a shape member.

methods.name: parse_list
methods.description: Parses a list shape from XML.

methods.name: parse_map
methods.description: Parses a map shape from XML.

methods.name: parse_float
methods.description: Parses a float value from XML.

methods.name: parse_integer
methods.description: Parses an integer value from XML.

methods.name: parse_boolean
methods.description: Parses a boolean value from XML.

methods.name: parse_timestamp
methods.description: Parses a timestamp value from XML, returning a DateTimeResult.

methods.name: parse_xml_attribute
methods.description: Extracts an XML attribute value, considering namespace and prefix.
